What schools serve Ladner in Delta School District 37?

Delta School District 37 operates Delta Secondary School (DSS) in central Ladner along with Ladner Elementary (French Immersion), Hawthorne Elementary, Holly Elementary, Neilson Grove Elementary, and Port Guichon Elementary, plus Sacred Heart Elementary private school.
How do Flood Construction Levels (FCL) affect building or renovating in Ladner?

Because Ladner sits on the Fraser River delta floodplain protected by municipal dikes, the City of Delta enforces specific Flood Construction Levels (FCL) and geotechnical rules for new residential construction and major structural additions, which also explain why most Ladner homes are built on crawlspaces or slab-on-grade rather than inground basements.
What highway and transit routes connect Ladner to Vancouver and Richmond?

Highway 17A links Ladner directly to Highway 99 (George Massey Tunnel to Richmond and Vancouver) and Highway 17 (South Fraser Perimeter Road to Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal, Highway 91, and Surrey). TransLink operates the Ladner Exchange park-and-ride with frequent express buses to Bridgeport Canada Line Station.
Are secondary suites and coach homes allowed in Ladner?

Yes. City of Delta zoning permits registered secondary suites inside single-family dwellings and detached garden suites / coach houses on qualifying residential lots, subject to floodplain elevation rules, lot coverage, and off-street parking requirements.
